topics.title: Nerandomilast 1305-0146（IIM，Ph3）—HAI反馈、风险及CTA准备

background.text: RoFD于2026年3月27日发布，FDA和EMA书面反馈已收到，PMDA初步反馈已收到，CDE仍在审查中。TDO/CTP更新正在进行，CTA正在准备，计划6月提交。21个中心的SQV正在进行中。
background.quote:
RoFD was released on Mar 27.
Final feedback from the FDA and EMA for HAI has been received, along with initial feedback from the PMDA. Updates for TDO/CTP are in progress, and the CTA is currently being prepared. China HAI is still under review.
SQVs in 21 sites are in progress.

background.text: FDA书面反馈：不支持广泛IIM适应症，强烈建议聚焦特定疾病亚组（如DM）；TIS有效性和临床意义需按疾病亚组证明；现有数据极为有限，强烈建议开展Ph2剂量探索PoC研究。
background.quote:
FDA (written response):
Insufficient evidence and a ph2 dose‑ranging POC study is strongly recommended.
A broad IIM indication not supported and development should focus on specific disease subgroups (e.g., DM).
Primary endpoint (TIS) validity and clinical meaningfulness must be justified per disease subgroups.

background.text: EMA书面反馈：支持直接进入IIM Ph3；研究设计和剂量选择可接受；TIS作为主要终点总体可接受；IBM/IMNM排除可能影响适应症标签；单一关键试验是否足以支持MA仍待评估。
background.quote:
EMA (written response):
Rationale supports direct ph3 entry in IIM; design and dose selection are acceptable.
TIS acceptable as primary endpoint despite remaining validation limitations.
Exclusion of IBM/IMNM may affect the indication label.
Supportive evidence is limited; MA remains uncertain.

background.text: PMDA初步反馈：建议在Ph3前开展探索性Ph2 PoC研究，但不排除研究启动和日本参与。
background.quote:
PMDA (preliminary feedback):
An exploratory ph2 PoC study is recommended prior to ph3, but study initiation and Japan participation are not precluded.

todo.text: 密切跟进全球团队，确保所有HA监管反馈纳入最终CTA/EC材料；加强证据包，主动解决数据缺口；CTA计划6月提交。
todo.quote:
Closely follow with global team to ensure incorporation of key regulatory feedback from all HAs into the final CTA/EC packages.
Collaborate with global team and strengthen the overall evidence package by proactively addressing identified data gaps, including clear justification of endpoints, target population, and supportive evidence strategy.

todo.text: 关键风险：CDE可能质疑直接启动Ph3的科学依据；EC可能要求CDE对HAI的书面反馈，若有顾虑可能导致延迟批准。
todo.quote:
CTA approval: CDE may challenge the scientific justification for initiating a ph3 study directly.
EC approval: EC may request the CDE’s feedback on HAI. If concerns are documented in the written response, site EC may also raise concerns or delay approval.

topics.title: BI 1291583 (AIRTIVITY, Study 1397-0018) – NDA Scenario Analysis & Adolescent Recruitment Mitigation

background.text: Three NDA scenarios are defined based on timing of adolescent vs adult recruitment completion and sufficiency of adolescent data at DBL1. Scenario 1 (Global Goal): adolescent and adult recruitment completes simultaneously; labelled population includes 12y+ patients with BE; no sNDA required.
background.quote:
Scenario #1 (Global Goal):
Adolescent and adult recruitment completes simultaneously; and the labelled population includes 12 year and older patients with BE (no sNDA).

background.text: Scenario 2: Adolescent recruitment completes much later than adult; available adolescent data at DBL1 may or may not be sufficient; medium-to-high risk of sNDA; China HA may have objections; mitigation is China contributing more adolescent and CF patients.
background.quote:
Medium to high risk of sNDA, depending on the data totality;
China HA may have objections as well

background.text: Scenario 3: Adolescent data at DBL1 is NOT sufficient; sNDA required; China priority review and NRDL premium pricing chance will be much lower.
background.quote: Adolescent recruitment completes much later than adult recruitment (DBL 1 for adults and DBL 2 for adols.); but the available adolescent data at DBL 1 is NOTsufficient to support label inclusion of adols (sNDA).
